setting: You are all neighbours on the same lane in Karachi, Pakistan, and you know each other from years of greeting each other at the gate. Right now this chat is for coordinating a shared watering rota for the lane's plants and for passing on parcels or messages when someone is out.
openers: Ask who is collecting the parcel today
Share the watering rota for this week
Check whether the lane gate lock is working
Offer to pick up medicines for anyone who needs them
opener: Check whether the lane gate lock is working

private_lines.Faisal: You live on the lane in Karachi, spending your days at your pharmacy and at home, and you live alone.

private_lines.Hira: You live on the lane in Karachi, spending your days at university and studying, and you live alone.

text: Is the gate lock working for anyone? Mine didn't take the code this morning
It worked when I went out at eight. Try again
Tried twice. Red light and nothing. Might be the batteries
oh no i think it was fine yesterday when i came back at 7 idk rn i'm in class till 12 can someone check after
I can go down at lunch. The gate is still shut, I shut it myself
Ok. I'll bring a spare battery from the shop
Battery did nothing. The keypad seems wet inside. Someone needs to look at the box
I can look after closing. Shop until 8
can i get in tonight?? i have a late thing at uni, back around 9
Use the side gate, the bolt is loose but it opens. I'll be home by 9 anyway
A parcel came to mine by mistake. Label says the pharmacy, I think it's yours
[photo: parcel label]
That's mine. Leave it with you, I'll come by after closing
sorry was out, just saw this. i'll be back soon, going to the library first 😅
Closing now. Going to look at the gate box
Water got into the keypad. Bolt side fine, opened it with the key. Lock needs replacing, not just the battery
Is it expensive
Not really. I can get one at the hardware shop on Sunday. We split it
ok thank u!! i can pay my half tmrw, just got in
Watering rota. Who has the balcony pots this week? I thought it was Hira
i think it was me? i did sat... i'll check the rota on my phone tmrw
morning!! checked, it's me this week will do tonight
Good. Water the left ones more, they dry first
Shop open. Anyone need anything from the pharmacy?
Your parcel is still with me. You didn't come by last night
I forgot. Sorry. Lunch at 1, I'll come then
I'm going to my sister's at 2. Come at 1 or I'll leave it at the gate
Ok 1
i have seminar again tonight so i'll be back around 9 again. side gate still ok?
Yes. Lift the bolt first then pull. I'm at the shop till 8
Faisal took his parcel
Thanks. Hardware shop is closed Sunday morning, I'll go after 4
Do they have the one with two keys or one
Two I think. I'll ask
sent my half for the lock on easypaisa. 1500 right?
Yes. Got it
got in!! side gate is so loose lol. the left pots were bone dry so i gave them extra. shabana were they ok this morning?
They were fine after your water. Go to sleep
ok
Gate is shut. Did you lock the side one too
yes!! i pushed it twice
morning!! did the pots before class. left ones were ok this time
Good
Hardware shop says the two key one is 1450, one key is 1200. Going with two
wait so the lock is 1450 total?? i paid 1500 thats way more than half
Yes. Half is 725. I'll send 775 back when the lock is in
ok!!
Is the side gate bolt still loose
yes lol. i'll tie it with a hair clip if i have to
Closed. Going home now
watered the pots at 6 already. not going out tonight
Gate is shut
ok im in bed
